control_test.question: Does the marker plpRedirect=mhFallback indicate a fallback, or does Amazon emit it on ordinary product pages too?
control_test.observed_page: CHEFMAN 8 Qt TurboFry product detail page: About this Item, Product Description, User Guide PDF, Proposition 65 block, buy box Present($79.91) and In Stock all rendered.
control_test.conclusion: A bare, untagged, direct load of a VALID 10-character ASIN also returns plpRedirect=mhFallback and lv=shuf. Therefore neither marker is evidence of a fallback, and neither distinguishes a valid ASIN from an unaddressable code.
control_test.supersedes: The uses of plpRedirect=mhFallback as proof-of-fallback in ledger/flags.json F-03 and F-05, and in README.md.

repeat_test.question: Is the destination content / btn_ref token unstable between requests (the 'shuffle' claim)?
repeat_test.procedure: https://link.amazon/B04G1MEwY fetched twice in the same session, at different times.
repeat_test.observation: Both responses resolved to /dp/B0CDY277D3 with the identical btn_ref=srctok-1e229870efde5acf, identical channelId=704, and identical page body.
repeat_test.conclusion: The per-link token is stable, not shuffled. The previously published 'different btn_ref on re-fetch' claim is NOT reproducible.
repeat_test.supersedes: ledger/flags.json F-05 and the README.md divergence table row 'Same-day re-fetch'.

cross_day_retest.question: Does the destination hold across days, and is the per-request token a stable identifier?
cross_day_retest.procedure: Each of the three supplied short links was fetched again, and each destination ASIN was requested directly as a bare, untagged /dp/ URL as a control.

observations.destination_title_observed: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black
Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven | 26QT air fryer oven with French doors, 24 cooking functions, dual-speed fan and rotisserie for easy family meals.

control.observed: HTTP 200 with the full CHEFMAN 6 Qt product page (buy box, About this item, User Guide). Amazon rewrote its own internal links to ?lv=shuf&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback&th=1.
control.conclusion: plpRedirect=mhFallback is emitted on an ordinary, untagged, valid product-page load. It is not evidence of a fallback.

cross_day_retest.conclusion: The destination ASIN never changed on any fetch across five sessions and two days, while the per-request srctok attribution token did change between days. A rotating source-attribution token on a fixed destination is the behaviour of a tracked source link. The token must therefore not be treated as a stable identifier of the link; only the destination ASIN is stable.
